sources.title: ornith-ai/Ornith-1.5-9B-MLX · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Ornith-1.5-9B is a dense ~9B model (≈19 GB in bf16), so it serves on a single 80GB GPU. The recipes below stand up an OpenAI-compatible server; add --tensor-parallel-size / --tp if you want to shard across more GPUs.

sources.title: Ornith-1.5-9B · LLM Releases
sources.snippet: The smallest model in DeepReinforce's Ornith-1.5 family (released 2026-08-19, MIT, weights on Hugging Face): a 9B-parameter dense coding/agent model trained with the family's self-improving task-and-scaffold RL loop, and shipped with a quantized 'Ornith-1.5-9B-Mobile' build that runs on iPhone and Android.

sources.title: Ornith-1.5: From Self-Scaffolding to Self-Improvement
sources.snippet: Ornith-1.5 extends the self-scaffolding framework introduced in Ornith-1.0 into a more complete self-improvement loop: the model proposes new tasks, generates task-specific scaffolds, and produces solution rollouts for reinforcement learning, continuously creating new learning experiences from which it can improve.
